shade.desc: Shade (1x): drifting blue-violet shape, fades in light.

gate_shade.desc: Gate shade (1.2x, Hel's Leave): tests the living-lamp; fades in light.

soul_wraith.desc: Soul wraith (1.3x): neon-blue drifting wraith (palette sky/white; neon glow = fx soul_glow), drifts through walls.

grave_lantern.desc: Grave lantern (1x): iron lantern of blue cold fire on clean bone legs; wakes as you pass.

bone_elemental.desc: Bone elemental (1.6x): clean pale bone, rune seams (violet = fx).

garnet_golem.desc: Garnet golem (1.8x, the 'blood golem'): dark red glass, slow; nothing wet.

skeleton_line.desc: Skeleton line (1x): clean pale bone with blue-violet rune belt, spear; march in step.

lich.desc: Lich (1.4x): dark hooded robe over a belted tunic, pale-blue eyes, staff-mace.

gloam_knight.desc: Gloam Knight (elite 1x): dark leather jerkin + violet (palette blue-shadow) tabard, belted, spear; NO plate.
